Steps: 1. Open the game and select Play. In multiplayer, join with controllers and enter names first.
Expected Result: The track loads and the race starts.

Steps: 1. Accelerate, steer left and right, then brake or turn touch acceleration off.
Expected Result: The kart responds to your controls. If the pace feels too fast or slow, you can mention it in Notes.

Steps: 1. Look at your name on screen before and after the race.
Expected Result: Solo keeps your assigned name. Multiplayer keeps each entered name with the right player.

Steps: 1. Finish the race and look at your time and statistics.
Expected Result: Results appear with your name and a sensible finishing time. Nothing looks mixed up or left over from another race.

Steps: 1. Open the leaderboard after finishing. Choose Today and All Time for solo, or Multiplayer for a group race.
Expected Result: Your name and time appear in the right boards. Solo may show an earlier faster best. The same finish is not duplicated.

Steps: 1. Select Retry Race after everyone finishes. In multiplayer, open the pause menu to find it.
Expected Result: A new race starts and controls still work.

Steps: 1. Open Highlights after a solo race. 2. Browse a card and try Share. Save the image or cancel the share window if you prefer.
Expected Result: The card shows your race. Sharing or saving works, and closing it returns control to the game. Cancelling does not send anything.

Steps: 1. Take turns steering with each controller, then drive together.
Expected Result: Each controller moves only its own kart. Names and screen areas stay with the correct players.

Steps: 1. Open the leaderboard website and try Today, All Time and Multiplayer.
Expected Result: Each tab loads its results or a clear no-results message. Names and times are readable.

Steps: 1. If you have just finished a race, find its result on the website.
Expected Result: The name and time agree with the game. Solo shows personal bests; multiplayer lists individual finishes.

Steps: 1. Think about anything unexpected during your match: invisible obstacles, driving on walls, falling through the road, getting stuck or disappearing objects. 2. If you noticed a bug, you can describe what happened and where. A screenshot is optional.
Expected Result: Choose No bugs noticed if you did not see another issue, or Found a bug if you did. Details are optional.
